decisions.reason: The spring-controlled flap weir sits close to the firm's core hydraulic steelwork, so it costs little to keep on the market, and its demand from municipal customers is still unresolved after a 2024 launch, which makes the option worth holding.

The energy management system fits the firm's strategic push toward digital networking and energy recovery, so its value is still uncertain but potentially large, and as a software module it is cheap to carry.
The overflow flap gate is close to the established offer and already has its own web page, which signals commitment, so keeping it costs little while market feedback accumulates.
